description: PAID $0.002 USDC. Name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply, ERC-20/721/1155 classification, and proxy implementation if it is a proxy. Requires address= and a single chain= (default ethereum). Returns JSON name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply, ERC-20, ERC-721, or ERC-1155 class, and proxy implementation when present.

address.description: Token or contract address. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Single chain. Format: a chain slug such as ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, bsc, or avalanche. Example: ethereum. Default: ethereum, as the existing tool text states.

name: lookup_token_info
title: Token/contract info ($0.002)
